info.description: Public type-specific FAQ and Skill authoring, publication, and exact-version API.

post.description:
Promotes the reviewed revision to one canonical unpublished FAQ.
Concurrent calls and retries resume or return the proposal's recorded target.
A complete target may be visible to management before the proposal reaches
promoted, but remains absent from serving until separately published.

limit.description: Optional request cap, still bounded by the Playbook discovery maxResults policy.

truncated.description: True when eligible fetched candidates exceed the result slots left by pins, independently of token admission. This count signal is bounded to the fetched candidates, not the entire index.

budgetTruncated.description: True when the token budget skips an eligible fetched entry while filling result slots. Later fetched candidates may fill those slots if they fit; admission stops at the result count limit or the end of the fetched candidates. Empty results with this flag do not mean no knowledge matched. Omitted means false; independent of count-based truncated.

score.description: Normalized cosine similarity: (2 - Redis cosine distance) / 2.

expectedProposalRevision.description:
Optional revision check for an open proposal; omission dismisses the current
candidate regardless of revision. A mismatch returns ProposalRevisionConflict.
Dismissal preserves the candidate for restoration; an already trashed proposal
is a successful no-op regardless of the supplied revision.

written another logical record or version and should not be blindly retried

ProposalSource.description:
Caller-supplied origin and observed material, not verified attribution.
On a proposal this is immutable creation context, excluded from evidenceCount.
On evidence this describes an additional observation relevant to the same need.
Reference locates the input; content preserves the submitter's observation or
excerpt. Both, when present, must be JSON objects. Their fields are source-specific.
RAM extraction uses agent-memory-session or agent-memory-summary references and
questionAnswer content; its question/answer are model-derived, not verbatim events.
See docs/specs/MOD-18196-playbook-extraction-readiness-follow-up.md for that contract.
